title: QUIC Zerortt Hosted Proof Gate Verification
verification_method: Requirement-home tests, helper dry-run planning, workflow review, artifact inspection, and hosted workflow dispatch when external evidence is required.
preconditions: The manual hosted workflow retains the advisory zerortt-server-proof profile.
The repo-local interop helper can be executed in dry-run mode.
The preserved hosted artifact bundles for the earlier zerortt attempts remain available for inspection.
scope: Verify that the repository classifies zerortt as supported/executed after hosted Linux packet-analysis proof exists and that partial hosted evidence does not promote the inventory cell.
procedure: Run `dotnet test tests\Incursa.Quic.Tests\Incursa.Quic.Tests.csproj -c Release -m:1 --filter "FullyQualifiedName~InteropHarnessRunnerTests|FullyQualifiedName~REQ_QUIC_INT_0002|FullyQualifiedName~REQ_QUIC_INT_0018|FullyQualifiedName~REQ_QUIC_INT_0021"` and confirm the classification-gate checks, the zerortt request-gap helper tests, and the buffered request-line read tests pass.

Run `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts\interop\Invoke-QuicInteropRunner.ps1 -DryRun -TestCases versionnegotiation,zerortt,connectionmigration` and confirm zerortt is supported/executed in the plan output.

Inspect `.github/workflows/interop-runner-handshake.yml`, `scripts/interop/README.md`, and `scripts/interop/Invoke-QuicInteropRunner.ps1` for the explicit `zerortt-server-proof` advisory profile and supported-cell wording.
Inspect `docs/current-status.md` and the owning INT artifacts for the closure wording and preserved proof evidence.

When external evidence is required, dispatch `gh workflow run interop-runner-handshake.yml --repo incursa/quic-dotnet --ref main -f coverage_profile=zerortt-server-proof` and inspect the preserved runner-report and packet-analysis logs.
expected_result: The repository classifies zerortt as supported/executed after the hosted Linux proof succeeds, and partial hosted proof or server-only dispatch does not control the inventory cell.
status_summary: Complete. The buffered request-line reader, helper inventory promotion, requirement-home tests, dry-run output, and hosted run 25777328991 all agree that zerortt is supported/executed. The hosted proof bundle records `0-RTT size: 10570` and `1-RTT size: 2379`.

supplemental_sections.heading: Deferred Coverage
supplemental_sections.content: `http3` remains out of scope. `v2`, `rebind-port`, and `rebind-addr` are supported/executed inventory cells but remain outside this verification scope. `connectionmigration` now has a dedicated hosted proof lane and remains outside this verification scope.
